coaching.coaching: Today's run was well within the MAF HR zone, with an average HR of 144bpm and a max HR of 157bpm, indicating a solid aerobic effort. The pace of 8:12/km was slightly above the target range, but the cadence of 169spm and power of 182W suggest efficient running mechanics. Ground contact time of 284ms and vertical oscillation of 7.5cm also indicate good running form.
